name: Groom Room
headline: Good hair days, measured in tail wags.
intro: Choose your dog’s breed for a clear guide price, appointment time, and the cut we recommend—before you ever pick up the phone.

services.name: Full groom
services.description: Consultation, two shampoos, conditioning, blow-dry, brush-out, nail trim, ear clean, and your chosen cut.

services.name: Bath & brush
services.description: A thorough wash, condition, blow-dry, brush-out, eye and hygiene tidy, finished with paw balm.

services.name: Puppy first visit
services.description: A gentle 45-minute introduction to the bath, dryer, table, brush, and the person behind the clippers.

services.name: Hand strip
services.description: Traditional coat care for suitable wire-haired breeds, preserving colour and weather-resistant texture.

faqs.question: What if my dog is matted?
faqs.answer: We put comfort first. We will assess the coat with you and agree a shorter cut or extra de-matting time before the groom begins.

faqs.question: Is the breed price guaranteed?
faqs.answer: It is a guide for a regularly groomed dog. Coat condition, size, temperament, and requested finish can change the final quote.

faqs.question: Can I stay during the appointment?
faqs.answer: Most dogs settle more easily without their person in view. You are welcome to see the salon and meet the groomer at drop-off.

faqs.question: What should I bring?
faqs.answer: Bring your dog on a secure lead and tell us about allergies, health needs, or anything that helps them feel safe.
